name: Engram Prime
description: Act 2, chapter `engram` (STORY.md §16): the `prime` mission on Rime, Engram Prime under the ice. Frozen plains cut by three winding crevasses; north of the Core an ice wall rings the well with a single gap (`ice-gate`). Inside, the mind-well: a circular shaft 40 u deep with a raised lip (`mind-well`, on the lip, for `engram-choice`), and three cores round it at 120° (`core-a`, `core-b`, `core-c`). If `engram-doubled` is set, two sentinels appear at each core as stand-in guards (`core-a-guard` …); destroying the cores is `engram-destroyed`. Frozen wildlife in two small herds, two nests far south, packs ×0.6 ("hostile to biology"). Engram is a faction here (team 3, neutral; engram-doubled turns it hostile, engram-defected allies it): the three cores are Fusion Cells (story flags core-a-down, core-b-down, core-c-down; all three set engram-destroyed), turrets inside the ice gate, masts and radar round the well, Skiff drones patrolling the well. Doubled: Tanks and Lancers appear at the cores. Defected: four Skiffs hold the gate for us. Expedition: 1,400 alloys, 200 isotopes, 4 drones, 6 Rovers, 4 Tanks, 4 Lancers, 2 Artillery, 2 Engineers.
